title: Number of 1 Bits
summary: Count how many bits are set in the binary form of a non-negative integer.

tests.explain: 64 is 1000000 in binary: a power of two has exactly one 1 bit.
2^31 - 1 is thirty-one 1 bits in a row, the largest allowed input.

hints: You could test each of the 31 bit positions with (n >> i) & 1. Can you loop only once per set bit instead?
Subtracting 1 from n flips its lowest set bit to 0 and every 0 below it to 1.
So n & (n - 1) is n with its lowest set bit removed. Count how many times you can do that before n becomes 0.

complexity.time: O(k): k is the number of set bits, at most 31
